performance.name: Hardtrance Demo
performance.description: 146 BPM · E minor · 256 bars / 7:01. Slow atmospheric buildup, rolling hard-trance bass, acid call, supersaw theme, breakdown at 3:30, main arrival at 5:16, final crest and fading outro. One-shot arrangement.

patch_definitions.name: Undertow Motion Pad
patch_definitions.description: Dark triangle and PWM pulse pad. Sine LFO moves pulse width from 0.32 to 0.68 and filter cutoff from 70% to 130% of Tone. Motion is Hz, not tempo sync. Suggested MIDI notes 43–79. Dry, velocity-sensitive, polyphonic. Three per-instance controls read on new notes. Route Stereo Output through the performance mixer to Master.

patch_definitions.name: Reverb Effect
patch_definitions.description: Stereo reverb effect, uses inleta channel names "left" and "right".

patch_definitions.name: Chakra Vowel Talker
patch_definitions.description: Talking pulse voice with two animated formant bands, a little fundamental, filtered dotted-eighth repeats and a chamber tail. MIDI 43–76. Built-in filtered echoes and reverb; no global FX needed. Velocity-sensitive, polyphonic, three per-instance controls read on new notes. Route Stereo Output through the mixer to Master.

patch_definitions.name: Alloy Sequence Voice
patch_definitions.description: Short metallic FM sequence voice. Ratio sets the modulator/carrier relationship; non-integer values are inharmonic. High-pass filtered to leave bass space. Suggested MIDI notes 48–84. Dry, velocity-sensitive, polyphonic. Three per-instance controls read on new notes. Route Stereo Output through the performance mixer to Master.

patch_definitions.name: Furnace Techno Stab
patch_definitions.description: Saw and square at one played pitch, saturated into an envelope-swept resonant filter. Play your own chords; no fixed chord or unison. Suggested MIDI notes 43–79. Dry, velocity-sensitive, polyphonic. Three per-instance controls read on new notes. Route Stereo Output through the performance mixer to Master.

patch_definitions.name: Prism FM Pluck
patch_definitions.description: A harmonic 1:3 FM pair with a bright onset that softens into a glassy pluck. Release controls the tail after key-up; decay controls held notes. Suggested MIDI notes 48–84. Dry, velocity-sensitive, polyphonic. Three per-instance controls read on new notes. Route Stereo Output through the performance mixer to Master.

patch_definitions.name: Rubber Core FM Bass
patch_definitions.description: One 1:2 FM pair plus a sine at the played fundamental. Growl fades with the envelope to a sustained rubbery body. Suggested MIDI notes 28–55. Dry, velocity-sensitive, polyphonic. Three per-instance controls read on new notes. Route Stereo Output through the performance mixer to Master.

patch_definitions.name: Psy Rotor Bass
patch_definitions.description: Phase-reset saw for rolling psy bass. Tone is the floor of a 3500 Hz envelope sweep; mild saturation precedes the ladder filter. Suggested MIDI notes 28–52. Dry, velocity-sensitive, polyphonic. Three per-instance controls read on new notes. Route Stereo Output through the performance mixer to Master.

patch_definitions.name: JP-8000 Supersaw
patch_definitions.description: JP-8000-inspired emotional trance lead (not a hardware emulation). Seven band-limited saws at -18/-11/-5/0/+6/+12/+19 cents with staggered phases and a stronger centered voice. Stereo spread -> resonant 24 dB low-pass with velocity-sensitive filter envelope -> dam compression -> subtle stereo chorus -> three dark rhythmic echoes per side. No reverb. Amp ADSR: 8 ms / 320 ms / 80% / 280 ms. Default delay tempo 138 BPM: left dotted eighth, right quarter. Edit delay_tempo_bpm to match your song (manual, not host synced); 138 gives 326/435 ms. Controls: detune_amount (0..1.5), stereo_width (0..1), filter_base_hz (default 3200), filter_sweep_hz (5800), filter_resonance (0.12), chorus_mix (0.22), delay_mix (0.28), output_level (1.25). Finite echo taps and a reserved tail let echoes finish after MIDI note-off. Polyphonic, velocity-sensitive; add global reverb to taste.

patch_definitions.name: Analog Drumkit
patch_definitions.description: Five velocity-sensitive analog synthesis voices selected by MIDI notnum through Switch. MIDI notenum 35: Bass drum (pitch-swept sine + click); 36: Bass drum distorted (saturated sine + click); 46: Hi-hat open (700 ms); 42: Hi-hat closed (85 ms); 38: Snare (two sine resonances + filtered noise). Hats use six inharmonic square oscillators plus noise. One-shot decays survive short MIDI note-offs. Silent default; stereo output; no samples. GM bass-drum slot 36 is used for the distorted variation.

patch_definitions.name: Event Horizon Riser
patch_definitions.description: Hold a note for a rising FM/noise swell; release it into a diffuse echo and reverb cloud. Rise controls time to peak. MIDI 36–72. Built-in filtered echoes and reverb; no global FX needed. Velocity-sensitive, polyphonic, three per-instance controls read on new notes. Route Stereo Output through the mixer to Master.

patch_definitions.name: Mycelium Stepped Bubbles
patch_definitions.description: Deterministic stepped pitch/filter motion makes burbling alien sequences from held notes. Two unsynchronized LFOs produce the step pattern; repeatable, not random. MIDI 36–76. Built-in filtered echoes and reverb; no global FX needed. Velocity-sensitive, polyphonic, three per-instance controls read on new notes. Route Stereo Output through the mixer to Master.

patch_definitions.name: Astral Laser Zaps
patch_definitions.description: Descending FM laser with an exponential pitch sweep, clustered 75 ms echoes and a bright room tail. Sweep is the starting pitch multiplier. MIDI 36–76. Built-in filtered echoes and reverb; no global FX needed. Velocity-sensitive, polyphonic, three per-instance controls read on new notes. Route Stereo Output through the mixer to Master.

patch_definitions.name: Orbit FM Bleeps
patch_definitions.description: Short FM chirps with six fading echoes and an orbiting pan. Chirp sets the upward pitch excursion at the onset. MIDI 48–84. Built-in filtered echoes and reverb; no global FX needed. Velocity-sensitive, polyphonic, three per-instance controls read on new notes. Route Stereo Output through the mixer to Master.

patch_definitions.name: Mandala Acid Lead
patch_definitions.description: Goa acid lead: driven saw, resonant envelope sweep, dotted-eighth echoes. Echo BPM is manual tempo, not host sync. MIDI 43–79. Built-in filtered echoes and reverb; no global FX needed. Velocity-sensitive, polyphonic, three per-instance controls read on new notes. Route Stereo Output through the mixer to Master.

patch_definitions.name: Goa Ray Lead
patch_definitions.description: Goa psytrance melody lead: saw + hollow square + single-pair FM bite, high-passed, saturated, resonant ladder filter, subtle flanger. Outputs: outleta left/right (full) and sendl/sendr (10% effect send).

patch_definitions.name: TB303 style Bass
patch_definitions.description: TB303 style bass with perf_controller settings for cutoff and resonance
